description: Multi-stablecoin settlement routing — given a source and destination currency pair, recommends the optimal stablecoin path based on corridor liquidity, regulatory fit, gas economics, and DPX native support. Returns a ranked list of stablecoins (USDC, EURC, BRLA, MXNC, NGNC, AEDX, PYUSD, USDT, and others) with regulatory flags, MiCA/GENIUS Act compliance status, liquidity tier, and warnings. Identifies blocked routes (e.g. USDT for EU under MiCA, BRLA before BCB Resolution 561 deadline). Use before settlement to avoid regulatory penalties and ensure optimal execution path.

amountUsd.description: Settlement amount in USD (used for liquidity tier and large-amount warnings).

name: stability.stablecoin_route

routes.description: Ranked stablecoin options — each with symbol, liquidityTier, regulatoryFlags, warnings, blocked status, notes
